item.coloph: de ltar rmi lam 'khrul snang 'di/ dkar chag yi ge ris su bris pa 'di/ bka' srung 'phrag dogs mi mdzad zhu/ 'di bris dge ba'i bsod nams kyis/ bdag gi pha ma nye 'brel dang / bdag dang bdag la 'brel ba yi/ bdag gi grogs mchog gyur pa rnams/ sgrib gnyis byang zhing tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ phyi ma o rgyan mkha' spyod dang / pad ma dbang gi bde chen du/ rig 'dzin gnas mchog sa thob shog pad ma mkha' 'gro'i 'o rgyal gyi zhus lan/ dge sdig rang mkhas skyon yon shan 'byed/ 'phrul gyi lde mig zhes bya ba/ bkra shis bde legs khyab rgyas shog u ya si ti sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya/ gab rgya//
